messages:
joel: heads up — finance flagged a batch of tenants where preview tokens > final invoice after sticky-router resyncs. seeing consistent 1-3% overcounts.
rhea: saw the same on the heatmap. spikes line up with sticky-router heartbeats (eu-central). likely duplicate pre-agg events.
ben: quick repro: force sticky failover -> two ingress instances accept same session for ~2-4s -> preview consumer (reads pre-aggregator topic) sees both, aggregator dedupes on commit later.
ops-bot: router: sticky-resync events=12 last 2h; affected_zones=[eu-central]; suggested_action=investigate-heartbeat-latency.
joel: short-term mitigation options: A) mark preview rows with ingest_stage and preview_confidence so UI can show "unstable" for affected tenants; B) apply cheap in-memory dedupe in preview consumer keyed by (request_id,fingerprint) with TTL=3s.
rhea: prefer B for noise reduction, but we still need auditability. finance wants a mapping from preview rows -> invoice rows for reconciliation. propose adding meta.preview_id stamped at ingress and copied into invoice rows at commit.
ben: agree. preview_id is small schema bump (meta.preview.v1). preview consumer dedupe should be opt-in per-tenant via feature flag so we can rollback. also emit metric preview.dedupe_hits and preview.delta_tokens.
finance-bot: billing-monitor: flagged_tenants=[3012,3050,4021], peak_preview_delta=2100 tokens at 2026-03-21T09:14:00Z. finance_contacted=true.
joel: plan: 1) ben implements in-memory dedupe + metric (PR today); 2) rhea adds preview_id spec + dashboard card linking preview->invoice (SQL mapping); 3) canary on 5 tenants in eu-central tonight; 4) ops stand-by to flip feature flag.
rhea: SQL for audit join (will include in PR):
```sql
SELECT p.tenant_id, p.request_id, p.preview_id, i.invoice_id, i.tokens, i.committed_at
FROM preview_events p
LEFT JOIN invoice_rows i ON i.preview_id = p.preview_id OR i.request_id = p.request_id
WHERE p.tenant_id IN (3012,3050)
ORDER BY p.event_time DESC
```
ben: timeline: draft PR for deduper in ~2h, metric + canary config after review. will add smoke test simulating sticky failover.
joel: ops action: tag @oncall-sre when canary flips and enable verbose router traces for 30m. finance will prepare credit guidance in case final invoices differ historically.
ops-bot: ticket-created: ENG-7021 'preview-delta-sticky-resync-audit' assigned=[ben,rhea], priority=high
joel: thanks. communicate to support: "preview is an estimate; final invoice is authoritative. we're rolling a fix to reduce overcounts during router resyncs."
